_doc: SOT-2648 — Sonnet-lane sentinel set for the Sonnet gold100 improvement cycle (official:false lane).
WHY A SEPARATE FILE: scripts/focused_sentinels.json pins CHAMPION (gemini-3.6-flash) stable
MATCHes; two of them (idx0 version_diff, idx11 document_extract) are reproducibly WRONG under the
Sonnet claude-mcp backend, so reusing the champion set would false-fail every Sonnet-lane gate.
This set pins questions the SONNET dev configuration answers correctly and reproducibly; if any
drops from MATCH during a cycle change, the gate FAILS. Tripwire, not a coverage claim.
GOLD SOURCE: artifacts/predictions_test_v3_final.csv (same gold gold_offline uses; judge=codex).
No gold values are embedded here; verdicts are re-checked live by run_focused_gate.py.
SELECTION BASIS (fixed 10, cross-type, det+LLM, 2-sample stability):
Only two full Sonnet gold100 samples exist so far — SOT-2628 dev (net18, artifacts/
gold100_sonnet_dev.json) and SOT-2642 cycle4 sonnet (net16, artifacts/gold100_cycle4_sonnet.json).
Each index below was (a) MATCH in the SOT-2628 run, (b) NOT WRONG in the cycle4 run and NOT in
the cycle4 flash->sonnet divergence list (docs/ai/model_divergence_cycle4.md) — i.e. MATCH in
both samples — and (c) for LLM-route picks, also a champion MATCH->MATCH question (stable across
models, the least flaky class). Single-sample Sonnet-only recoveries (idx5/17/36/53/56/79/80/96)
were deliberately NOT used: one sample is not stability (SOT-2623 lesson).
Balance: 3 deterministic-lane picks (model-invariant, byte-exact — all deterministic-direct idx
agree across backends per SOT-2642) + 7 LLM-loop picks across 6 archetypes. During the first
live cycle gate, idx16/71 produced the correct value plus variable provenance text and Codex
rejected the extra wording; they were replaced by idx3/81, which meet the same two-sample rule
and retain document_extract coverage with exact verbatim extraction asks.
MAINTENANCE: keep exactly 10, keep the type + det/LLM balance. Re-vet from fresh Sonnet gold100
samples as they accumulate; swap an index only when its Sonnet verdict stops being reproducibly
MATCH. Never hand-edit a verdict or embed a gold answer.
baseline: SOT-2628 Sonnet dev gold100 net18 (match46/abstain26/wrong28, official:false)
